# Golden fixtures

Generated by `pnpm --filter @nazr/thumbmark fixtures` from the client implementation. Do not edit by hand; regenerate instead.
- `stringify.json`: `[{ name, input, stringified, hash }]`. `stringified = stableStringify(input)`, `hash = hash(stringified)` (murmur3 x86 128, 32 hex chars).
- `numbers.json`: `[{ value, expected }]`. `value` is the JSON number (so `-0` appears as `0`) and `expected` is `String(value)` evaluated in JavaScript.
- `filter.json`: `[{ name, components, options, filtered }]`. `filtered = filterThumbmarkData(components, options)`, computed with `navigator` undefined so the browser is inferred from `components.system.browser.{name,version}`, as on the server.
- `-0` cannot be represented in JSON; the Go side must unit-test `StableStringify(-0) == "0"` itself.
